title: The Invoice That Favored Us by Mistake
script: Bagas: [curious] Mira, did you check the supplier's invoice this month? Something looks strange to me.
Mira: [thoughtful] I glanced at it earlier. Why, did the total seem off to you as well?
Bagas: [carefully] They billed us for three hundred units, but I'm fairly sure we actually received closer to four hundred and fifty.
Mira: [surprised] Are you sure? If that's true, we've been undercharged for weeks, not just this month.
Bagas: [honestly] I checked our warehouse records twice already, and the numbers don't match at all, so I don't think it's my mistake.
Mira: [hesitant] Honestly, part of me wants to just stay quiet about it. Our budget has been stretched thin since the new project started.
Bagas: [understanding] I get that completely, and believe me, I thought about staying quiet too, even if only for a moment.
Mira: [thoughtful] However, if we say nothing and they eventually notice their own error, we'll look like we deliberately let it slide.
Bagas: [gently] That's not even the main reason for me, though. Even if they never noticed, we would still know exactly what happened.
Mira: [reflective] You're right. As a result, staying silent would essentially mean deciding to keep money that was never actually ours.
Bagas: [determined] Exactly. So I think we should contact them directly, explain the discrepancy, and offer to pay the corrected amount.
Mira: [worried] What if they think we're only saying something now because we're worried about getting caught later?
Bagas: [calmly] That's possible, but their opinion of our intentions isn't really something we can control either way.
Mira: [thoughtful] True. Despite the risk of looking suspicious, doing the right thing shouldn't depend on how it might be interpreted.
Bagas: [warmly] Exactly my thinking. Besides, our supplier has always treated us fairly, even when shipments were delayed on our side.
Mira: [sincere] Okay, let's draft the email together this afternoon, and I'll ask finance to recalculate the correct balance before we send it.
Bagas: [relieved] Thank you for agreeing so quickly. I was a little worried you'd want to wait until next quarter instead.
Mira: [smiling] No, if something's wrong, it's better fixed now, even though it costs us more this month than we planned for.

quiz.question: What did Bagas notice about the supplier's invoice?
options: It was for the wrong company
They were billed for fewer units than they actually received
The prices had doubled
The invoice was missing entirely
quiz.explanation: Bagas noticed they were billed for three hundred units but had actually received closer to four hundred and fifty.

quiz.question: Why does Mira initially want to stay quiet about it?
options: She dislikes the supplier
Their budget has been stretched thin since a new project started
She thinks it's not their responsibility
She doesn't believe Bagas
quiz.explanation: Mira admits their budget has been stretched thin, so part of her wants to stay quiet.

quiz.question: What does Bagas say matters more than whether the supplier notices?
options: Getting a reward for honesty
Knowing what happened even if the supplier never notices
Avoiding paperwork
Impressing their manager
quiz.explanation: Bagas says that even if the supplier never noticed, they would still know exactly what happened.

quiz.question: What do Mira and Bagas decide to do?
options: Ignore the mistake completely
Contact the supplier, explain the discrepancy, and offer to pay the corrected amount
Wait until next quarter to mention it
Ask a lawyer to intervene
quiz.explanation: Bagas suggests contacting the supplier directly and offering to pay the corrected amount, and Mira agrees.

quiz.question: How does Mira respond to the risk of looking suspicious?
options: She decides it's better to say nothing
She says doing the right thing shouldn't depend on how it might be interpreted
She blames Bagas for the situation
She asks to delay the decision indefinitely
quiz.explanation: Mira concludes that despite the risk of looking suspicious, doing the right thing shouldn't depend on interpretation.
